{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve crew-neck top, hip length, ivory #F2EDE4, merino wool

Refined knit: slim-fit turtleneck sweater, hip length, deep burgundy #6B1F2E, fine-gauge wool-cashmere blend

Trousers: straight-leg, ankle-to-floor length, charcoal #3A3D42, brushed wool-blend with a fully lined interior

Warm tights: opaque, worn under the trousers, black #1A1A1A, fleece-lined microfiber

Coat: single-breasted, knee-to-mid-calf length, dark navy #1F2A3D, heavy wool-blend with a quilted lining and a hood-friendly high collar

Boots: ankle-to-mid-calf, block heel, black #111111, waterproof treated leather with a grippy rubber lug sole and a warm shearling lining

Hat: snug knit beanie, charcoal gray #55595F, thick merino wool

Scarf: oversized, wraps twice, camel #B58B5A, soft lambswool

Gloves: full-finger, black #151515, leather with a cashmere lining

Work bag: structured tote, medium size, black #1C1C1C, water-repellent coated canvas with leather trim

Why this outfit works: It keeps you properly warm on a 20-minute walk through deep frost and snow, with layers that trap heat and a lined coat that blocks the wind. The turtleneck, wool trousers and polished boots keep the look neat and professional for the office, so you can step in and be ready without changing. The waterproof, lug-soled boots grip snowy pavement and stand up to the road salt, and the water-repellent tote keeps your things dry. The burgundy and camel add some warmth of color against the calm charcoal and navy."}
